⚡

Golang Clean Architecture Engine

High concurrency, sub-millisecond response times, zero-allocation money arithmetic, and modular domain architecture.

🖥️

Next-Gen React Portals

Sleek, responsive Administrator and Client portals built with Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui.

🌐

Multi-Driver Provisioning

Out-of-the-box support for cPanel, Plesk, DirectAdmin, HestiaCP, CWP, and generic Webhook microservices.

💳

Extensible Payment Gateways

Multi-currency billing with Stripe, PayPal Express, Midtrans (QRIS/VA), Bank Transfer, and dynamic custom gateways.

🛡️

Enterprise Anti-Spam & Security

Built-in honeypot, disposable email blocker, IP rate limiting, SHA-256 fingerprinting, and audit logging.

🌍

Full Internationalization & i18n

Multi-language dictionaries with automatic LTR and RTL (Arabic) directional layout switching.
